title: Disassembly of Progressive Cavity Pump
overview: This work instruction provides step-by-step guidelines for disassembling a Progressive Cavity Pump.

steps.title: Remove the set plug for the drive pin
steps.description: Loosen the bolt and remove the set plug from the housing to access the drive pin.

steps.title: Remove the hold down plug and drive pin
steps.description: Screw out the hold down plug, go to the other side, remove the alignment tool, and lightly tap on the drive pin.

steps.title: Remove the cap screws
steps.description: Use a 3/8-inch drive ratchet with a 3/4-inch socket to remove the cap screws and the cap.

steps.title: Mark the position of the cap
steps.description: Place a mark on either side of the cap to ensure it is installed in the same position when reassembled.

steps.title: Remove the stator and rotor
steps.description: Use a large pipe wrench to loosen the stator and rotor from the housing. Use a leverage bar pipe to unscrew the stator and rotor.

steps.title: Slide out the stator and rotor
steps.description: Use a helper to slide the stator and rotor out of the housing assembly and set it on the ground.

steps.title: Check the seal on the connecting rod
steps.description: Verify that the seal on the end of the connecting rod is in place and not damaged.

steps.title: Inspect the connecting rod washer
steps.description: Check if the connecting rod washer is defective or not in place, which can cause corrosion and water seepage.
